title: SGOED — The Arrow of Time Is Not in the Ensemble: An Audited Toy-Model Quest across Equilibrium Matrices, Sequential Growth, and Causal Sets (Preprint v7)
description: Audited toy-model quest for the arrow of time. Core findings: (1) equilibrium Monte Carlo is time-symmetric — eleven structural observables (R, D, d_MM, d_s, G, cycle ratio, time-reversal, order, repulsion, dynamic order, entropy rate) all fail under a six-gate audit; (2) three process constructions give robust directional time — Past Hypothesis (rank-1 initial state: dS/S0=0.98, ~100× random), Sequential Growth (chain inheritance 1.000±0.000, deterministic, scale-free M=8–32; mechanism: contraction to the past mean; with a rank-1 frozen origin: 0.9995±0.0002), and Upwind Transport (decay 5849×, J=+5.773±0.016, reversal- and null-audited); (3) the 4D question closes negatively in every audited framework (matrix SSB, bounded noncommutativity, Lorentzian real-time dynamics, random percolation — whose "d≈4 at N=250" is a finite-size artifact —, SOC and curvature feedback self-tuning); (4) one structural discovery: relational light-cone locality is the condition for scale-invariant causal dimension (std across N of 0.002–0.013 vs 0.26–0.82 for percolation), including a commutator-compatibility metric on real growth states (d≈3.5, std 0.008) — the dimension value remains parameter-steered, not spontaneous. The six-step audit protocol and a 12-trap catalog ship as a runnable toolbox (code/audit_gates.py) with the full v8–v14 evidence slice (audit_evidence/). All claims reproducible with fixed seeds; engineered toy, not an emergence claim.
